name: HC3Finance
description:
The HC3 dataset comprises tens of thousands of comparison responses from both human experts and ChatGPT across various domains, including open-domain, financial, medical, legal, and psychological areas. The data collection process involved sourcing publicly available question-answering datasets and wiki texts, ensuring that the human answers were either expert-provided or high-quality user responses, thereby minimizing mislabeling and enhancing the dataset's reliability.
